text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from a walk, I run into

Matikanetannhauser and some of her
friends, and
we all head back to the
academy.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Geez... I can't believe I ended up
nodding off
during hide-and-seek...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. We were playing with some kids
as part of
our volunteer work.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
But I ended up falling asleep in the
middle of the
game...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to get so down about it!

Everyone looked like they were having a
great
time.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
But Tannhauser, I have to ask, where the
heck did
you hide?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Even after the kids left, we still couldn't
find you.
We were panicking, thinking
something had
happened to you.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I heard we were gonna play
hide-and-seek at the
park, so I went
ahead and scoped out the best
spots
beforehand.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Wait, don't tell me...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Is that notebook filled with hiding
places?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I don't get it, though. I thought I'd
picked a spot
where even a kid should
be able to find me
easily...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...Wait!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Could it be that I'm so normal and
boring that the
kids just forgot about
me?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Um, no... I really think it's just that you
hid too
well...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh, this is no good at all! I've got to
become an
Umamusume brimming with
character so nobody
will forget me
again!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Um! I think you're fine and memorable
just the
way you are!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the vote of confidence! But
it's
okay—I'm determined to be better!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
So, this is where I ask you, the
professional
trainer, to give me some
advice.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: You're so right! Tracen Academy is full of unique Umamusume!
choice_data_list: 他のウマ娘に相談するとか
そのままでいいと思うよ

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Okay! I'll go talk to them!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Uniqueness, you say? Ah, I see... you
long to be
even a fraction as remarkable
as myself, the great
T.M. Opera O!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Excellent! Put those feelings into song!
Come,
play it for me! The aria of your
soul!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Um, okay—here goes! Oh, how I
praaaay! ♪ That
I will becooome a
unique Umamusumeeee! ♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Well, th-that was a beautiful song, but...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Maybe that's not the best way to define yourself, Tannhauser...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You wish to be unique? Hehe, what a
splendid
proposition! Here, I'll give you
my newest
concoction!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Just one sip and you will transform into a
truly
magnificent being, one that has
transcended the
limits of an
Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Can it really do all that?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: STOOOOP!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: That's too dangerous!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many times her friends
try to stop
her, Matikanetannhauser's
desire to define herself
cannot be
quelled.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Stay as I am? You mean "stay ordinary
and
boring"?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't call you ordinary per se... but
you're
wonderful just as you are!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes! You're always hardworking and

straightforward, Tannhauser! You're
already the
best you!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Wowww! Thank you so much, everyone!
choice_data_list: 悩むことなんて何もないよ

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Stay as I am, huh? Hehe. I'm feeling
pretty
confident all of a sudden.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
So, instead of worrying about how to be
me... I
just need to keep trying my best
in my own way.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I gotta keep it simple and not overthink
it. Just
keep my eyes on the prize and...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Completely reinvent myself through
fashion and a
new haircut!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Why would you do that?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that, the three of us desperately
try to stop
Matikanetannhauser from
choosing bizarre wigs
and clothes.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I see what you're doing... You're trying
to comfort
me, aren't you?! That's such a
kind gesture...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm... Can kindness be a unique trait?
Maybe
if I'm kind to enough people...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Uh, Tannhauser?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Like helping people in trouble or
searching for
lost cats from missing
posters...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Um, don't you do that stuff already?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I think that'll work! All right, it's go
time!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, everyone! I'm gonna become
super kind!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Um, Tannhauser?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: She ran off...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser runs off with new
resolve. A
short while later...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I found a cat and helped a bunch of
people, but...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Now that I stop and think about it,
helping
people in trouble is actually
pretty normal. I
mean, any average girl
would do the same.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe I was trying to become
unique by
doing totally normal things...
What was I
thinking?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Sigh... This is so embarrassing. But at least...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I got thanked by even more people than
usual
today! Hehe...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though Matikanetannhauser seems to
think she
failed, there are no signs of
regret in her smile.
